subject: Activation sprintcard: GPU pool routing, burst policies & regional selection
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Activation sprintcard: GPU pool routing, burst policies & regional selection

Hi Sarah — great to be moving into activation. Attaching a light sprintcard and a checklist so we can lock dates. High level ask below; Monica/Marcus/Karthik are looped for CS, infra, and onboarding coordination.

What I need from Optima this week:
- Preferred primary region (us-west-2 / us-east-1) and any strict no-go regions
- Peak concurrent inference requirements (p95 qps or steady concurrency target)
- Any procurement constraints (PO lead time / billing contact)

Our proposal (short):
- Provision a 32-GPU pool in your preferred region (reserved baseline) with a 2x burst buffer in a sister region for cross-region bursting.
- Autoscale policy: target p95 latency SLO, scale-up by whole-GPU increments with 90s warm-up, burst policy allows ephemeral non-reserved capacity for up to 30% of sustained throughput for 6 hours/day initially.

Attached: redwood-activation-sprintcard-v1.xlsx (timeline and checkpoints).

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Nov 13 — 60min kick-off + network/VPC runbook review. If that works please reply with region and confirm attendees.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
[kimberly.park@redwood.com]

[Attachment: redwood-activation-sprintcard-v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@optimahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation sprintcard: GPU pool routing, burst policies & regional selection

Thanks, Kimberly — excited to get started. Quick answers:
- Primary region: us-east-1 (we have a data residency preference toward east coast).
- Peak: planning for ~120 concurrent short-context inference sessions (avg 2.5s outputs), with headroom to 180 for launches.
- Procurement: PO will take ~10 business days; our legal wants a short SOW addendum.

I attached the security questionnaire that our InfoSec requires for any vendor with private deployment access. Can Marcus/your infra team confirm the VPC peering and KMS flow?

Also available for kickoff Mon Nov 13 at 10am ET. Attendees: me, our infra lead (Jason Park), and procurement contact (procure@optimahealth.com).

Best,
Sarah
Program Manager — AI Platforms, OptimaHealth

[Attachment: Optima_Security_Questions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@optimahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Nov 2028 13:22:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation sprintcard: GPU pool routing, burst policies & regional selection

Thanks for the questionnaire, Sarah — I started a pass. A few immediate clarifying Qs so we can scope network/VPC setup correctly:

1) Will you provision a customer VPC with dedicated subnets for Redwood ingress, or do you want us to spin up a managed VPC endpoint in your account?
2) KMS: do you require use of your KMS keys (customer-managed) for token logs/metrics at rest, or is envelope encryption with Redwood KMS acceptable during initial activation?
3) For cross-region bursting, is inter-region traffic acceptable, or do you need all traffic to stay within us-east region at all times?

Answers will determine whether we provision a sister pool in us-west-2 for burst or configure burst in us-east across AZs only.

I'll tag items in the questionnaire with proposed responses and follow-ups before the kick-off.

—Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@optimahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 10:02:18 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation sprintcard: GPU pool routing, burst policies & regional selection

Appreciate the timing, Sarah — looking forward to the kickoff today. Quick operational notes that will shape the sprint:
- Typical onboarding cadence: Week 0 (kickoff & network), Week 1 (pool provisioning + smoke tests), Week 2 (canary traffic + performance tuning), Week 3 (go-live). We can compress to 2 weeks if Optima provides fast PO/creds.
- Canary plan: start with 5% traffic routed to the dedicated pool behind a feature flag; monitor token-level latency, error-rate, and cost-per-token for 72h before increasing traffic.
- Escalation: Marcus -> Monica -> Kimberly for infra or perf incidents; optima should route customer-impacting incidents to procure@optimahealth.com + sarah.cho@optimahealth.com.

I'll bring the rollout checklist and a short runbook to the call.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference
